items.english: May I turn off the air conditioner before I open the window?

items.english: May I put my luggage here before I sit down?
items.target: すわるまえに、にもつをここにおいてもいいですか
items.note: すわる (sit down). A verb before まえに (mae ni, "before") is in its dictionary form, as in ねるまえに (neru mae ni) from Lesson 17. Then this lesson's てもいいですか (may I).
items.reviewNote: Owner request 2026-10-12: a sentence in this lesson's theme using すわる, the dictionary form added to the base unit in the same batch.
